caseName: Inter-State National Bank of Kansas City v. Luther
caseNameFull: Inter-State National Bank of Kansas City v. Luther, Trustee
attorneys: Frank H. Terrell for petitioner and the First National Bank of Kansas City. John F. Eberhardt for respondent.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. Motion to add the First National Bank of Kansas City as a party petitioner granted. Petition for writ of certiorari granted.
